_comment: Cache-classification rules for CacheScanner. One of several files under Data/definitions/ — see README.md. All files here are merged at load; cache rule lists are unioned (case-insensitive).

cache._comment_alwaysSafeNames: Bare folder names that are ALWAYS safe to delete (unambiguous transient render/compile artifacts).
cache._comment_cautionNames: Cache-like names that may hold app data → require opt-in.
cache._comment_cautionPathFragments: Paths forced to Caution even if named Cache (package stores, etc.).
cache._comment_safeContextFragments: A generic 'cache' folder is safe only when its path contains one of these known app/tool contexts.
cache._comment_denyFragments: Never touched even if the name contains 'cache' — security stores and profile data that is NOT a cache. This list is the deny-list every scanner funnels through; losing it is why the loader fails closed.
